description: Civgraph persons elected to a council in Northern Ireland or the Republic of Ireland, linked to the Wikidata item of the same person where Wikidata itself records the council (a councillor/member position, a mayoralty or chair of that council, a qualifier naming it, or a description naming it) and the names and dates agree. Pairs that fail the date tests or are not one-to-one are listed under `ambiguous` with the reason and are not links.

method.population: Civgraph persons (person_id on candidacies) elected at least once to a council body: pre-1973 Northern Ireland county, county borough, borough, urban and rural district councils and town commissioners; Northern Ireland local government districts 1973-2023; Republic of Ireland county and city councils 1974-2024.
method.candidates: Wikidata humans with (A) P39/P463 statements whose value is a council-specific position, office or council item for an Irish or Northern Irish council (councillor in X Council, member of Belfast City Council, Lord Mayor of Belfast/Dublin/Cork, Mayor of Derry/Galway/Waterford, Cathaoirleach of X County Council, the council items); (B) generic council member/alderman/mayor/deputy mayor P39 statements (citizens of Ireland, the Irish Free State, the UK or the UK of Great Britain and Ireland) whose qualifiers name the council or its city/county; (C) every P39/P463 statement of items already in official-person-crosswalk.json; (D) humans whose English description names a council or mayoralty (Irish citizens, members of Irish and Northern Irish parties, UK citizens whose description names a Northern Ireland place).
rules: NAME: the Civgraph display name or a recorded name form equals the Wikidata English label or an en/ga alias after normalisation (case, accents, punctuation, honorifics, post-nominals and bracketed disambiguators removed; 'Mc X'/'Mac X'/'O X' joined). Variants only when the rest is exact: extra single-letter middle initials (consistent with any full middle name), or a listed short form or Irish/English equivalent of the first name. A bare initial as first name never matches. Never matched on name alone.

BODY: the Wikidata evidence names a council the Civgraph person was ELECTED to. Renamed bodies count as one (Belfast Corporation / County Borough Council / City Council; Londonderry Corporation / County Borough Council / Derry City Council; Dublin Corporation / Dublin City Council; Cork, Galway, Limerick and Waterford Corporation / City Council; Dublin County Council = Fingal, South Dublin and Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown for elections before 1994; a Northern Ireland borough mayoralty = that borough council before 1973 and the district council of the same name after). Merged successor councils match only themselves. The directly elected Mayor of Limerick (2024-) is not council evidence.

DATES: every Civgraph candidacy of the person is in or after the Wikidata birth year + 18 and on or before the death date (year precision when Wikidata gives only a year); dated body evidence (P580/P582/P585) overlaps, +-1 year, the span from the first election to that council to 6 years after the last; at least one Wikidata date (birth, death or dated body evidence) exists.

UNIQUE: exactly one Wikidata item satisfies the rules for the person and exactly one Civgraph person for the item; an item tied by official ids (official-person-crosswalk.json via person_registry officialPersonIds) to another Civgraph person is not re-linked.
OFFICIAL IDS: when person_registry already ties the person to the item (wikidata:Q in officialPersonIds), identity is given; BODY and DATES must still hold.
